The petitioner has filed this writ petition with a prayer for payment of 75% Additional compensation as per Section 40(5) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,

sentences.text: Counsel for petitioner submits further that award could not be prepared.

The date of enforcement of RFCTLARRA (RFCTLARR Act 2013) which is Published in Gazette of India on 27.09.2013 and by virtue of Section 114 of the RFCTLARR Act ( the Old Acquisition Act, 1894) has been repealed.
There is special provision made in Section 40(5) of the new Act to pay additional compensation.
In this regard, the Director of Land Acquisition, Bihar has published a letter no.1475 dated 07.12.2014 by which 75% additional compensation has to be calculated.
Counsel for petitioner submits that he has filed this writ petition only with a view to comply the Annexure-5 and its consequential benefit attached to said Annexure-5 due to its implementation.
Counsel for State submits that from the record, Annexure-2 series, it transpires that award has been prepared in 2015, in the name of petitioner.

In this background and due to change in position of Patna High Court CWJC No.179 of 2023(2)
dt.19-06-2023 law, petitioner is directed to represent before the Collector, Patna with all his grievances along with the copy of writ petition, who is directed to assure the payment of petitioner in the light of Annexure-5 to the writ petition within 6 weeks from the date of filing representation by the petitioner before him, if he is entitled for the same.
With this direction, this civil writ application is hereby disposed of.
(Dr. Anshuman, J.) prakashmani/-
